exec: pm.test('Response echoes the requested task order', function () { pm.expect(result.taskIds).to.eql(expected); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('baseUrl') + '/tasks?projectId=' + pm.environment.get('projectId') + '&orderBy=position', method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('token') } }, function (error, response) { pm.test('GET position order returns the reordered IDs and gap-free positions', function () { if (error || !response) { pm.expect(error).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response).to.exist; return; } pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const tasks = response.json().slice(0, 3); pm.expect(tasks.map(function (task) { return task.id; })).to.eql(expected); pm.expect(tasks.map(function (task) { return task.position; })).to.eql([1, 2, 3]); }); });
pm.test('New task position follows existing tasks', function () { pm.expect(created.position).to.be.greaterThan(3); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('baseUrl') + '/tasks?projectId=' + pm.environment.get('projectId') + '&orderBy=position', method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('token') } }, function (error, response) { pm.test('New task is last in position order', function () { if (error || !response) { pm.expect(error).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response).to.exist; return; } pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const tasks = response.json(); pm.expect(tasks[tasks.length - 1].id).to.equal(created.id); }); });

pm.test('Deleted task ID returns 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('Incomplete task list returns 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
